description: The latest Goldback premium multiple over its gold content, and the exchange rate that follows from it.

base.description: A currency code from the live catalog at /api/currencies (ISO 4217 fiat plus BTC and the metal codes). Defaults to USD.

name: get_goldback_rate

goldContentTroyOz.description: Fine-gold content of one Goldback note.

goldSpotPerTroyOz.description: Underlying gold spot price per troy ounce in the base currency.

premiumMultiple.description: Multiple applied to the note's contained-gold spot value.

rateDate.description: Effective date of the premium multiple.

ratePerGoldback.description: Price of one Goldback: goldSpotPerTroyOz × goldContentTroyOz × premiumMultiple.

spotAsOf.description: UTC update instant of the gold spot input.

title: Goldback exchange rate
